hebrews.12.p1.b1.text: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.

hebrews.12.p1.b2.text: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, …

hebrews.12.p2.b3.text: Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.

hebrews.12.p2.b4.text: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.

hebrews.12.p2.b5.text: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”

hebrews.12.p3.b6.text: Endure suffering as discipline; God is treating you as sons.

hebrews.12.p3.b7.text: For what son is not disciplined by his father?

hebrews.12.p3.b8.text: … but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His holiness.

hebrews.12.p3.b9.text: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.

hebrews.12.p4.b10.text: Therefore strengthen your limp hands and weak knees.

hebrews.12.p4.b11.text: Make straight paths for your feet, so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.

hebrews.12.p5.b12.text: Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.

hebrews.12.p5.b13.text: See to it that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his birthright.

hebrews.12.p5.b14.text: For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected. He could find no ground for repentance, though he sought the blessing with tears.

hebrews.12.p6.b15.text: For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom, and storm; to a trumpet blast or to a voice …

hebrews.12.p6.b17.text: … “If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned.”
